All probes local under /tmp/probe and /tmp/rev44clone; no cloud/model provider contacted, no credentials used, no secret files read.

F1 MEDIUM (reproduced, scripts/build.ts:84): buildConfig() always uses join(repositoryRoot, "src", "cli.ts") even though compileCli/packageCli accept root and use it for packageVersion (scripts/build.ts:94) and repositoryCommit (scripts/build.ts:110). Trigger: packageCli({root: someOtherTree}). Consequence: archive name, metadata version/commit and --help output all describe the other tree while the code is this repository's. Reproduction: /tmp/probe/root-probe.ts with /tmp/probe/altroot (version 9.9.9-alt, one commit) produced swarmforge-v9.9.9-alt-linux-x64-glibc.tar.gz + metadata-9.9.9-alt.json (commit f1d7b3d2) whose binary is this repo's build. Guards don't help: scripts/package.ts:287 compares two values from the same root, and verifyArchive only checks define'd strings, the digest and the binary's own --version/--help; no test or CLI path passes root, so impact is latent. Fix: thread root into buildConfig or delete the parameter.

F2 LOW (scripts/package.ts:75): checksums() lists only the executable, so the README's documented `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` (README.md:50-52) leaves metadata-<version>.json - the only operator-visible version/commit/target record - uncovered. Not executed (needs a tampered archive). Fix: manifest line for metadata plus updated verifyArchive expectations.

F3 LOW (scripts/build.ts:109): repositoryCommit checks only the 40-hex format, so a dirty tree is stamped with a clean HEAD that does not describe the shipped source; the workflow's `--help | grep "build $(git rev-parse HEAD)"` compares against the same HEAD. CI checkouts are clean, so latent. Fix: cleanliness check in packageCli.

F4 LOW (scripts/build.ts:25): advertisedPlatform is exported with no importer; the live copy is scripts/package.ts:40. Editing the dead copy changes nothing and no test binds the archive name/platform. Fix: delete or single-source it.

Verified correct: bun-types 1.4.2 documents autoloadDotenv/autoloadBunfig as default true and autoloadTsconfig/autoloadPackageJson as default false, so only two of the four flags are load-bearing - and both work (target binary ignored a foreign .env/bunfig.toml/package.json/tsconfig.json, also files placed beside the executable; a control binary compiled without the flags read the foreign .env). Source runs with --no-env-file --config=/dev/null ignore the same foreign .env while a bare run reads it. `bun scripts/build.ts` reported version 0.1.0 / commit d428e0f7; a control define build reported 9.9.9 / cafecafe..., proving substitution through the typeof guards at src/version.ts:29,43. bun-linux-x64-baseline is a valid CompileTarget; output is ELF x86-64 dynamically linked to glibc with max symbol GLIBC_2.17, matching advertisedPlatform linux-x64-glibc.

Limitations: full packaging test suite and whole suite not run (whole-suite reviewer only); release workflow reviewed statically (no Actions run, no package:verify/draft-release execution); F2/F3 code-evidenced but not reproduced end-to-end; no cross-target builds.
